raw: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-16"?><CalculationBase xmlns:i="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" i:type="XScriptExpressionCalculation" xmlns="http://schemas.intelex.net"><Expression>IF(COUNT(QuestionAnswers)=0, COUNT(PubChecklist.PubQuestions), COUNT(QuestionAnswers)) + SUM(SubChecklists.ApplicQuestions) </Expression></CalculationBase>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-16"?><CalculationBase xmlns:i="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" i:type="XScriptExpressionCalculation" xmlns="http://schemas.intelex.net"><Expression>IF(MasterChecklist<>NULL, CONCATENATE(MasterChecklist.Path, ".", RecordNo), RecordNo)</Expression></CalculationBase>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-16"?><CalculationBase xmlns:i="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" i:type="XScriptExpressionCalculation" xmlns="http://schemas.intelex.net"><Expression>IF(AND(FindingStatus.Code<>"Closed", FindingStatus.Code<>"Closed without Action"), 1, 0)</Expression></CalculationBase>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-16"?><CalculationBase xmlns:i="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" i:type="XScriptExpressionCalculation" xmlns="http://schemas.intelex.net"><Expression>IF(PubQuestion.AnswerTypeCode="Choice", 
	Choice.Name
,
	IF(PubQuestion.AnswerTypeCode="Date",
		CONCATENATE(Date, "")
	,
		IF(PubQuestion.AnswerTypeCode="Float", 
			CONCATENATE(Float, "")
		,
			IF(PubQuestion.AnswerTypeCode="Text", 
				Text
			,
				IF(PubQuestion.AnswerTypeCode="Checkbox", 
					CONCATENATE(Checkbox, "")
				,
					""
				)
			)
		)
	)
)</Expression></CalculationBase>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-16"?><CalculationBase xmlns:i="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" i:type="XScriptExpressionCalculation" xmlns="http://schemas.intelex.net"><Expression>IF(OR(
	AND(PubQuestion.AnswerTypeCode="Choice", Choice<>NULL), 
	AND(PubQuestion.AnswerTypeCode="Choices", COUNT(Choices)>0), 
	AND(PubQuestion.AnswerTypeCode="Date", Date<>NULL), 
	AND(PubQuestion.AnswerTypeCode="Float", Float<>NULL), 
	AND(PubQuestion.AnswerTypeCode="Text", Text<>NULL), 
	AND(PubQuestion.AnswerTypeCode="Checkbox", Checkbox<>NULL)
	),1,0)</Expression></CalculationBase>
